description: Quote a private swap from a private Gloam balance: what you would get, the route, the vault's fee, and the first thing that would stop the swap (too thin a pool, a refund the vault could not take back, the relay's floor where gas is dear), or none. Read only: it never builds or sends a swap. A private swap hides who swapped; the tokens and amounts are public. To swap, use the Gloam app or the local server (npx -y @gloamtrade/mcp, gloam_execute_private_swap).

amount.description: How much of `from` to swap, in whole units, e.g. "100" or "0.05".

from.description: The asset you pay with: a symbol (USDG, ETH, USDC.e) or a token address.

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG, GLOAM, PONS, CASHCAT, ETH, AI and ORBIO), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), "base-mainnet" (Base mainnet: USDC, EURC, USDT, ETH), "ethereum-mainnet" (Ethereum mainnet: USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC, ETH), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet), "base" (Base Sepolia) or "ethereum" (Ethereum Sepolia).

to.description: The asset you receive: a symbol or a token address.

name: gloam_swap_quote
title: Quote a private swap
